name: C4 Container Diagram (Level 2)
description: C4 Container Diagram (Level 2) describes the technology containers in the system: Web Application, API Application, Database, Message Queue. Each container is a separate deployable unit (process, service, storage).
purpose: Describe backend architecture at the container level: technology used, responsibilities, and communication.
bestFor: Describe technologies used (React, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka)
Create architecture documentation for the development team
notSuitableFor: Describe system overview → go back to Level 1 (Context)
Describe component details inside container → go to Level 3 (Component)
Describe entity/class in detail → go to Level 4 (Code)
useCases: Define list of containers in the system
Draw communication between containers (REST, gRPC, message queue)
Add external system from Level 1 if needed
requirements: Containers — deployable unit: app, service, database, queue

elements.name: Container
elements.description: Deployable unit: Web App, API, Database, Queue, Cache

elements.description: Container technology: React, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis
